label: RESPECT_1: the intended carrier of respects, a parameter tagged across modules
term: respect, the intended carrier of respects of a proposition
definition: A binder tagged RESPECT_1 is the type of respects of the intended interpretation, with the content of DEF-RESPECT: that with respect to which a thing is moved, or is in act or in potency, such as being hot, being in a place or having being (esse); the quarta via reads a respect as a perfection (ST I q.4 a.1). Two binders tagged RESPECT_1, wherever declared, range over the same respects.
note: Stipulative carrier-sense record, attribution deferred; its content is DEF-RESPECT. It is a separate record, after the pattern of the frame-field records of IN_ACT_4 (5cbd5a0a) and the esse respect (eafd5d52), because DEF-RESPECT is linked by about 160 statements, claims and arguments whose labels say 'respect': making DEF-RESPECT itself a sense would require every one of them to carry a sense tag in its label without changing what any of them says. Merging this record into DEF-RESPECT is a follow-up. Introduced for the parameter-level carrier tags of the #1832 follow-up (attempt b979db99).

formal_gap.meaning: The type of respects of the intended interpretation: that in which beings are moved, in act or in potency, more or less, and caused, read in the quarta via cluster as perfections. A binder so tagged is a type parameter; the tag fixes which domain it denotes, not any relation over it.
examples: The distinguished respects esse (having being) and verum (being true, said of things).
exclusions: A being: a respect is that in which something is in act, a being what is in act (DEF-RESPECT); Lean does not enforce the separation of the two carriers.
A constructed model's respect type such as Bool, Unit or NecessarySimplePlurality.Respect (RESPECT_2): facts about it hold of the model only.
open_obligations: Which respects there are, which are perfections and which admit of more and less are supplied by the premises that state them, not by the carrier.
Whether esse differs from every other respect, or verum from esse, is not fixed by the carrier; the convertibility readings are explicit premises.
